# Doble AI

> Doble AI is a bilingual (English and Spanish) AI implementation firm based in the Eagle River Valley, Colorado. We audit a business's digital presence, map its competitive landscape, build its brand and sales presence, and implement AI workspaces that learn the business and keep learning it. Rooted in Colorado, working nationally and across the border.

Founded by John and Gisella Rounds. Doble AI is the AI services brand of **Eagle River Base Camp**, the Colorado LLC behind the work; contracts and invoices carry the Eagle River Basecamp LLC name. We are an AI-native firm, which means we run our own operation on the systems we sell: persistent workspaces, automated site-health and search-visibility monitoring, and bilingual publishing pipelines that we built for ourselves before we offered them to anyone. Every engagement starts with a free audit.

Spanish is native-quality work, not translation. Gisella is a native Peruvian Spanish speaker and leads translation and cultural review, so Spanish-language content reads as though it was written in Spanish, because it was. Bilingual is a decisive edge when the market calls for it. English-only work stands on its own.

## Quick reference

- **What we are**: bilingual AI implementation firm (not a marketing agency, not a reseller)
- **Legal entity**: Eagle River Basecamp LLC, Colorado. Brand lockup is "Eagle River Base Camp / Doble AI"
- **Based**: Gypsum, Colorado, in the Eagle River Valley. We know the Vail, Roaring Fork and Steamboat markets well
- **Reach**: Colorado and nationally, plus work in Mexico and upstate New York. Location is not a constraint
- **Languages**: English and Spanish, both delivered natively
- **Entry point**: a free audit. Paid work is scoped per project, never hourly
- **Contact**: WhatsApp +1 970 376 2725, or the audit request form at https://dobleai.com

## Services

- **Business Audit** — a full diagnostic of online presence, competitors, and gaps, delivered as a detailed written report. Where every engagement starts. Delivered in 5 to 7 days.
- **Competitive Landscape Analysis** — we map the competitive environment, identify where a business is losing ground, and find the white space competitors have not claimed. Included with the audit or standalone.
- **Brand & Sales Growth** — digital presence buildout, content strategy, and a plan that turns a brand into a revenue-generating asset. English, with Spanish for businesses ready to grow that market.
- **AI Implementation** — we build an AI workspace that learns the business: persistent memory, accumulated workflows, bilingual agents. Not a one-time setup. A system that compounds. Custom scope per engagement.

## Who we work with

Small and mid-size businesses in construction and trades, real estate, hospitality, professional services, and nonprofits. Especially businesses serving or trying to reach Spanish-speaking customers, and especially owners who are good at what they do and invisible to the people looking for it.

Client work includes luxury real estate in the Vail Valley, a lakeside realtor in Chapala, Mexico, a bilingual filmmaker and photographer's portfolio, specialty trade contractors, and independent local publications. Public audit deliverables live at https://jroundshp.github.io/doble-ai-deliverables/

## What we believe

- **Being findable is a separate problem from being good.** Most of the businesses we audit are excellent and effectively invisible. Fixing the site is not the same as fixing the findability, and the second one is usually the emergency.
- **The parts are cheap. The months of tuning underneath are not.** Anyone can wire up an AI tool in an afternoon. What makes it useful is the accumulated context, the corrections, and the standards that only exist because someone kept at it.
- **Nothing should start from zero.** AI that resets every session is a toy. The value is in a workspace that remembers your clients, your workflows, your voice, and the decisions you already made.
- **Bilingual when your market calls for it, excellent either way.** We do not force Spanish into markets with no Spanish-speaking base. Where the market is real, translation is not enough and it shows.
- **Rooted, not limited.** We are in a Colorado mountain town on purpose. It has never determined who we can work with.
- **Report what is visible, and verify it at the source.** An audit that claims something does not exist when it merely could not be seen is worse than no audit.
